messages:
Maya: Quick handoff to CS  Mercury Health (start-up) signed AM. Annual contract, $36k ARR. Sales promised Private (VPC) + SAML SSO. Renewal window: May 2027 (flagged for early touch).

Evan: Taking CSM. Who's their infra contact and what's the go-live window?

Maya: Infra lead is Jonah (jonah@mercury.health). Go-live target = 5 weeks. Sales included pilot KPIs: p95 < 70ms for 256 tokens, embeddings 200/min. Pilot 14 days, usage cap applied.

Rosa: Support Eng here. I'll own runbook and alerts. Need SAML metadata and CIDR. Also confirm if they require customer-managed KMS.

Maya: Jonah said they prefer CMK but will accept Redwood KMS for pilot. SAML metadata promised by EOD. Legal flagged data handling (PHI) and wants data-seg checklist.

Tyler: I'll provision infra once CIDR is provided. Proposed test cluster: 1xA10 int8, prefix cache off for cold-start measurement. Config snippet:
```
cluster: demo-dedicated
GPUs: 1xA10
quant: int8
cache: disabled
SLO: p95 < 80ms
```

Rosa: Alert thresholds draft: error rate > 1% over 5m, p95 > 200ms -> page oncall. I'll create MERC-ENG-1 ticket and attach runbook.

Evan: Enablement: schedule a 30-min walkthrough for Jonah's infra team week 1, and a 45-min product session for their ML lead. Also we'll run a 3-question survey after pilot milestones.

deploy-bot: Created ticket MERC-ENG-1 assigned to Rosa.

Maya: Sales note: if pilot uses >80% of cap we need a billing conversation. Also sales promised a limited "predictability" discount if they commit to Dedicated within 30 days.

Evan: Action items recap:
- Evan: schedule kickoff + enablement (by Thu)
- Tyler: provision staging once CIDR received (hold)
- Rosa: create MERC-ENG-1 and draft runbook (today)
- Maya: share SAML metadata + contract excerpt (done when available)

Rosa: I'll post runbook link to MERC-ENG-1 and set escalation to oncall -> Rosa -> Tyler -> Evan. Expect first draft in ~2hrs.

Tyler: Once CIDR + SAML are in I'll request peering and start provisioning. If they require HSM we need procurement sign-off.

Evan: Note on renewal ops: mark as medium risk until PHI checklist cleared. If pilot KPIs are met early, ops will recommend early upsell for Dedicated. I'll flag in SFDC and set a follow-up in Q4 2026.

Maya: Thanks team  leaving handoff to you.
